 Kanhu Sahu .

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram :Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Gautam Kumar Choudhary .........
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Chandrajit Mukherjee, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Sudhir Kr. Mahto, App
For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Manoj Kr. Dash, Advocate ......
04/ 16.06.2023.

Apprehending his arrest, petitioner above-named has moved this Court for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Complaint Case No.83 of 2021 registered under Sections 498A/
406/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 3/ 4 of the D. P. Act.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is the husband and the matter has been amicably settled in Mediation Centre and the report of the same is on record.
Learned APP for the State assisted by learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 while opposing the prayer has not disputed the factual aspect of the matter.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel and the fact as discussed above and in terms of the settlement arrived at Mediation Centre, JHALSA, Ranchi, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

Hence, in the event of his arrest or surrender within a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order before the learned court below, the petitioner named above shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below, subject to the conditions laid down under Section 438(2) Cr. P.C. (Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) Sandeep/uploaded.
